::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 35,199 people lived in County Leitrim, up 9.8% on 2016. It had the smallest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 23% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Leitrim was €992, the second lowest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Leitrim

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Leitrim was €24,960, the 23rd highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Leitrim was €225,500, the third lowest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 3.5 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Leitrim, the third lowest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 23% of households in County Leitrim rented their home, the 21st highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 20% of people living in County Leitrim were born outside Ireland, the 6th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 41% of people aged 3 and over in County Leitrim said they could speak Irish, the 13th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 30% of people at work in County Leitrim worked from home for at least part of the week, the 10th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 78% of people travelling to work in County Leitrim went by car, the third highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Leitrim live more than 4.2 km by road from a GP, the third furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Leitrim live more than 39.8 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the third furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 17.6% of County Leitrim in 2021, the second highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
